name: Full api suite: 1 failing test blocks the QA gate
description:
`qa_review_changes` ran the FULL api suite and reported **1700 passed, 1 failed** (critical `tests.failed`), so the QA gate on every change is currently `block`. The failing test is not named in the gate summary and it does not come from the diff under review (that diff is client-only `.vue`, `mapped_sources: 0`).

What to do:
1. Reproduce: `qa_run_tests(suite="pytest:api")` (full run, ~500s) or `pytest api/tests -x -q --tb=short` and read the single failure.
2. Classify it: real regression, environment-dependent (Docker/browser/voice/LLM credentials) or flaky (`qa_flaky_check`).
3. Fix the code, or mark the environment-dependent test as skipped with a reason — never delete it to make the gate green.
4. Re-run the full suite and leave a green result, so `qa_review_changes` stops blocking every MR.

Acceptance: one full `pytest:api` run with 0 failed, and the failing id written in this card's next comment.
